intent.title: Own verification in the Build controller with Candidate-bound receipts

evidence.locator: controller verification flow, context scrubbing, and same-cycle record/history persistence
controller-owned cycle execution and local Verification Record write
fake lifecycle coverage of failed-then-passed verification and Stop inactivity
recorded receipts: /attempts/0/check and /attempts/0/targets/1 both passed

scenarios.reason: The controller runs verification outside the Developer process, scrubs inherited contexts, owns verification state/history, and the recorded check and live-shape-to-build targets passed.

evidence.locator: failed-cycle resume path uses the same Developer session and verification retry budget
retry exhaustion and outer-attempt reset implementation
resume, exhaustion, fresh-context, and superseded-objection tests
outer resumption behavior tests

scenarios.reason: Failed verification resumes the exact Developer session, counts against verification retries, exhausts before Review, and starts a fresh context on outer resumption.

evidence.locator: provider-only passed receipt reuse and fresh offline-target execution
counting-target tests cover unchanged, changed, failed, and new-attempt cases plus forged bindings
handoff and review-packet reuse reporting assertions

scenarios.reason: The implementation reuses only passed provider-backed receipts bound to the same Candidate, catalog, and context; check and offline targets rerun fresh, and the reuse marker is surfaced in reports and packets.

evidence.locator: per-target process-group runner, exit/timeout/cleanup status, output log digest
receipt binding, evidence capture, and settlement integrity validation
binding, lingering-process, status, and failed-evidence tests
target-evidence manifest snapshot and validation tests

scenarios.reason: Receipts contain the required Candidate, attempt, context, catalog, cycle, timing, log, cleanup, and evidence bindings; status is derived from runner facts and tampering controls are tested.

evidence.locator: inert no-context branch and retained v1 unified protocol
PreToolUse-only Candidate preflight and unchanged gate registration
Stop hook context-case tests
Makefile and verification catalog inspected with no Candidate diff
verification catalog inspected with no Candidate diff

scenarios.reason: The Stop runner is inert without a valid v1 context, preserves the older v1 path, keeps the gate registration, and the Makefile and catalog remain unchanged.

evidence.locator: fixture creation omits Stop scripts and retains PreToolUse, discovery, resume, and helper requirements
offline compatibility contract and evidence assertions
recorded native evidence shows blocked gate and same-session resume without hook receipts
recorded live-native target passed

scenarios.reason: The compatibility fixture no longer copies or depends on Stop scripts, while retained evidence shows the blocked gate and exact-session resume; the live-native target passed.

evidence.locator: explicit target-union planning and no implicit check requirement
uniform target execution and policy environment
target selection and renamed-gate guard tests
catalog and Check validation tests

scenarios.reason: Target selection is explicit, dependency- and rank-validated, uses one uniform receipt list, and the guard derives all catalog target names instead of special-casing check or live.

evidence.locator: Candidate catalog-as-data validation and declared-addition rules
Intent catalog_changes.add parsing and validation
added, removed, edited, and missing-selected-target fixture tests
same-Developer failure routing for invalid selected targets

scenarios.reason: Declared additions are admitted and checked against Candidate catalog/Make data each cycle, while invalid selected targets fail verification and return to the same Developer.

evidence.locator: Candidate and base focused selector execution, red classification, preservation checks, and workspace rebuild
git-archive workspace creation, digest validation, volatile-cache rejection, and isolated environments
fixture tests for real red proofs, empty/assert-true/live rejection, base runner isolation, tampering, preservation, legacy labels, and timeout errors
fixture contract and catalog integrity validation

scenarios.reason: The controller runs Candidate selectors itself and enforces base fail/pass semantics with an isolated, digest-checked admission workspace; timeout and infrastructure errors are not treated as red proof.

evidence.locator: surface diff computation, retained full diffs, catalog digest, and base-suite report
per-launch ledger schema and exact disposition validation
weakening dispositions converted to blocking Review findings
ledger, packet bound, base-suite, and harness-schema tests
bounded packet index and retained diff assertions

scenarios.reason: The controller retains and indexes surface diffs, reports the base suite without gating on it, and enforces exact Reviewer ledger dispositions with weakening routed to blocking rework.

evidence.locator: offline-first paid-target selection wording and explicit verified_by contract
maintained Kogen policy and one-paid-target rule
prompt and README contract assertions
scenario contract wording assertions

scenarios.reason: The shared prompt and maintained README reserve paid targets for provider-only observables, make verified_by explicit, and state the offline-first policy.

evidence.locator: maintained self-hosting expand-and-contract guidance and concrete controller inputs
README source-location and worked-example assertions

scenarios.reason: README documents the two-step self-hosting migration, lists the Candidate inputs and source locations, and gives the Stop-removal/live-native follow-up example without adding this guidance to the shared prompt.

evidence.locator: shared retention module copies full scenario-tracking trees and rewrites summary record paths
both Shape fixture retention call sites use the shared module
sidecar preservation, deletion, alteration, and post-cleanup resolution controls
recorded live-shape-to-build target passed

scenarios.reason: The Shape fixture now retains complete tracking directories, including sidecars, packets, and verification artifacts; offline controls preserve strict sidecar resolution and the live target passed.
